items.title: Marriott signs agreement with Adarsh Group for 397-key St. Regis hotel in Bengaluru
items.why: Marriott is adding ultra-luxury keys in India, expanding St. Regis redemption options for Bonvoy-linked premium cards.
items.summary_ai: Marriott signed an agreement with Adarsh Group to open a 397-key St. Regis hotel in Bengaluru.
items.take: Marriott is adding ultra-luxury keys in India, expanding St. Regis redemption options for Bonvoy-linked premium cards.
